title: Instakill (Library of Ruina)
description: Every librarian (Player faction) die rolls 999 and its damage fields are set to 999, and every non-librarian a librarian die hits is killed right after the game's own damage call, whatever its resistances, immunities, 0 damage or immortality. Host callbacks on observation gates. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Instakill
launcher.note: Librarian dice roll 999, and whatever a librarian die hits dies at once, even enemies that resist, are immune, take 0 damage or cannot die

obs._comment: main build ID (first 16 bytes of the module ID, 32 hex digits) -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; word = the 4 bytes at offset read as a little-endian u32, or "auto": the rewriter takes the game's own word (dm/tools/patch_nso.py prints it, so check it against the function). Offsets are the RVAs of dump.cs / script.json (main = RVA + 0x234000 in the DmIOS file).

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: BattleDiceBehavior.UpdateDiceFinalValue epilogue (every path that stores _diceFinalResultValue at 0x244e980 reaches it, and so do the early exits): x19 = the BattleDiceBehavior
BattleDiceBehavior.GiveDamage, right after stp w25,w8,[x19,#84] stores _diceResultDamage / _diceDamageAll: x19 = the BattleDiceBehavior
BattleUnitModel.OnTakeDamageByAttack entry (the game calls it after TakeDamage has applied, or refused, the hit): x0 = the unit that was hit, x1 = the attacking BattleDiceBehavior
BattleUnitModel.AfterGiveDamage entry (after the hit has been applied): x0 = the attacker, x1 = the unit that was hit
